channel.title: CerberusMrXi
channel.description: Offensive security research, exploit notes, and CTF writeups by Sudeepa Wanigarathna.

item.title: React2Shell: Hunting RCE in Next.js Server Components
item.description: How CVE-class flaws in React Server Components / Next.js can lead to RCE — and how React2Shell helps defenders find exposed surfaces.

item.title: TryHackMe — Introductory Linux Privilege Escalation Notes
item.description: A practical writeup-style checklist for Linux privilege escalation: enumeration, SUID, cron, sudo, and kernel pitfalls.

item.title: Exploiting Buffer Overflows: A Deep Dive into Stack Smashing
item.description: A comprehensive guide to understanding and exploiting classic stack-based buffer overflow vulnerabilities in x86/x64 Linux binaries.

item.title: Web Cache Poisoning to RCE: HackTheBox — Cache Machine
item.description: Full walkthrough of the Cache machine from HackTheBox involving web cache poisoning, SSRF, and privilege escalation via Docker socket abuse.

item.title: Building a Custom C2 Framework in Go: From Scratch
item.description: Learn how to build a basic Command & Control framework using Go for the implant and Python for the operator console. Educational purposes only.

item.title: PicoCTF 2024 — Crypto Challenge: RSA Unpadded Oracle
item.description: Solving a tricky RSA challenge using an unpadded message oracle (blinding) attack to recover plaintext without the private key.
